ownerRequest: Let's pick topics for tonights generation, give me 7 options and i'll pick the 3 we go with
selectionPolicy: Nick will choose three. Do not select substitutes, render or change the production queue before the reply. The global recurring target is not changed by presenting options.
adaRationale: Practical personal tech problems with readable proof early, one clear payoff and one small CTA. These are editorial hypotheses, not measured performance winners.

options.topic: Turn meeting notes into confirmed actions
options.hook: Did anyone actually agree to that deadline?
options.outline: Use a synthetic meeting excerpt to separate suggestions from agreed tasks, owners and dates. Show the quote beside the action table.
options.cta: Check the agreed owner and deadline before creating the task.

options.hook: The automation retried. Did your customer get the email twice?
options.outline: Demonstrate a local simulated outbox with a stable job identity and a check of the first result. Do not send real messages or imply all providers support idempotency.
options.cta: Check the first result before retrying the send.

options.hook: Your AI read the document. Whose instructions did it follow?
options.outline: Use a harmless labeled document example to explain the distinction between source text and authorized instructions. Show an instruction-boundary flow. Do not claim any prompt makes injection impossible.
options.cta: Treat document text as evidence, not permission.

options.topic: Shorter AI prompts with a master SOP
options.hook: Why are you pasting your entire SOP into every AI request?
options.outline: Compare a full pasted SOP with a focused task brief that retains governing instructions and a master SOP reference. Measure actual input size; do not promise equal output quality or cost savings without a matched test.
options.cta: Keep one master SOP and prepare a focused task brief.

options.hook: You scheduled nine a.m. Nine a.m. where?
options.outline: Convert one dated event between named time zones and UTC, then show the actual timestamp and clock comparison. Do not alter real schedules.
options.cta: Check the date and time zone before scheduling.

options.topic: Check a QR code after video export
options.hook: Your QR code scans in the image. Will it scan in the video?
options.outline: Test an approved public QR URL in source artwork, actual encoded frames and smaller viewing samples. Show actual decode results; do not invent a failure.
options.cta: Scan the final video before scheduling it.

options.topic: Check whether AI citations support the claim
options.hook: Your AI answer has sources. Do those sources actually support it?
options.outline: Compare a claim with the exact passage in a real primary source. Use labeled illustrative claims or actual saved model output; never fabricate a model error. Show a claim-to-evidence table.
options.cta: Open one source and check the exact claim.
